description: Create an order and get a secure Stripe checkout_url. The order is confirmed only after payment at checkout_url (pay it yourself if you are able to complete a card checkout for your user, otherwise give the link to your user). Always confirm tier, total price, recipient, address, date and card text with the user first. Reuse idempotency_key on retries.

address_line1.description: Street address in Manhattan, e.g. '245 E 19th St'.

agent_name.description: Optional: name of the AI agent/app placing the order (helps us support you).

buyer_email.description: Buyer's email for the receipt and delivery confirmation.

card_message.description: Text for the card (handwritten for classic, romantic and grand; printed for petite and sweet), max 300 characters.

delivery_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in New York time. Omit for the earliest available date.

delivery_instructions.description: Doorman, buzzer code, 'leave with front desk', etc.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: reuse the same key when retrying so the order is never created twice.

recipient_name.description: Full name of the person receiving the flowers.

recipient_phone.description: Recipient's US phone number. The courier calls it for building access.

sender_name.description: How the card is signed, e.g. 'Love, Daniel'.

tier.description: Which bouquet: petite ($89), sweet ($119), classic ($159), romantic ($229) or grand ($749). All prices include card, delivery and tax.

name: create_order
title: Create a flower order
